description:
Performance profiling of the running game: frame timing percentiles, hitches, memory, GPU info and Unreal Insights traces.
Workflow: frame_timing for an overview -> find_hitches to locate spikes -> memory_report / gpu_stats for the cause ->
start_trace, reproduce, stop_trace, then open the .utrace in Unreal Insights for detail.
name: profiling

tools.description:
Samples frames and lists the worst hitches with their time offsets.
Returns: {frames, hitch_count, worst:[{at_s, ms}]} with the slowest frames first. Fails if seconds is outside 0.1 - 60 or hitch_ms is not positive.
tools.name: profiling.find_hitches

at_s.description: Seconds from the start of sampling.

tools.description:
Samples real frame times for a few seconds.
Returns: {frames, avg_ms, fps, min_ms, p50_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, max_ms, hitches, last_frame:{game_ms, render_ms, rhi_ms, gpu_ms}}. Fails if seconds is outside 0.1 - 60 or hitch_ms is not positive.

hitch_ms.description: Frames at or above this many ms count as hitches, e.g. 50.

tools.name: profiling.frame_timing

last_frame.description: Thread breakdown of the most recent frame.

game_ms.description: Game thread time of the most recent frame (0 without rendering).

last_frame.title: ProfilingToolThreadTimes

tools.description:
RHI, GPU adapter, GPU frame time, viewport size, screen percentage and vsync.
Returns: {rhi, adapter, gpu_ms, viewport:[w,h], screen_percentage, vsync}.
tools.name: profiling.gpu_stats

gpu_ms.description: GPU time of the last frame.

tools.description:
Process memory, UObject count and the most common object classes.
Returns: {used_physical_mb, peak_physical_mb, used_virtual_mb, available_physical_mb, uobjects, top_classes:[{class, count}]}. Fails if top_classes is outside 0 - 100.

top_classes.description: How many classes to list (0 - 100; 0 skips the object scan).

tools.name: profiling.memory_report

returnValue.description: {used_physical_mb, peak_physical_mb, used_virtual_mb, available_physical_mb, uobjects, top_classes:[{class, count}]}. Fails if top_classes is outside 0 - 100.

top_classes.description: Most common object classes, most objects first (empty when top_classes is 0).

count.description: Live objects of exactly this class.

returnValue.title: ProfilingToolMemoryReport

tools.description:
Starts an Unreal Insights trace to a file in the project's Profiling folder (an existing file is never overwritten: a numbered name is picked).
Returns: {file, channels}. Fails with wrong_state if a trace is already running, not_allowed if file is a path, unsupported if tracing is not compiled into this build.
This cannot be undone: only call it after explicit direction or permission from the user.
tools.name: profiling.start_trace

returnValue.description: {file, channels}. Fails with wrong_state if a trace is already running, not_allowed if file is a path, unsupported if tracing is not compiled into this build.
returnValue.title: ProfilingToolTrace

tools.description:
Stops the running trace.
Returns: {file, open_with}: the .utrace path and the program to open it with. Fails with wrong_state if no trace is running.
This cannot be undone: only call it after explicit direction or permission from the user.
tools.name: profiling.stop_trace

returnValue.description: {file, open_with}: the .utrace path and the program to open it with. Fails with wrong_state if no trace is running.
returnValue.title: ProfilingToolTrace
